'''Hadrium alloy''', often called simply '''hadrium''', was an alloy used in the production of the [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. One such blaster which used hadrium was a [[KYD-21 blaster pistol/Legends|KYD-21 blaster pistol]]. It was employed in the barrels of blasters due to its lack of malleability and high melting point.
